races.paceDynamic: Overbudget and Skip To Victory will clash early as both are confirmed front-runners, likely creating an honest gallop from the start. This should set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses Button It and Star Marian to close late, while Ring Of Diamonds can track the pace from a prominent position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners duel hard
scenarios.trigger: If Overbudget and Skip To Victory engage in a sustained battle through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and both leaders weaken in the final furlong. Button It and Star Marian benefit most from the strong gallop to finish powerfully.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One leader dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Overbudget or Skip To Victory gains a clear advantage and dictates terms solo
scenarios.body: The winner gets an easy lead and controls the race from the front. Ring Of Diamonds can track the pace and challenge, while the closers have too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical affair unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners are mindful of each other and the early pace becomes steady
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical allowing Ring Of Diamonds to sit closer and Zoulette to use her unknown ability. The strong finishers still get their chance in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Overbudget and Skip To Victory are reluctant to make the running early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl that doesn't suit any running style properly. Form and class become paramount with the highest-rated horses having the edge regardless of tactics.

watchPoints.text: Overbudget and Skip To Victory both breaking alertly could create a damaging early duel
Button It and Star Marian need the pace to develop early or they'll struggle to get competitive
Zoulette's positioning early will reveal her preferred running style and intentions
Ring Of Diamonds must avoid getting trapped behind the dueling leaders if they go too fast
The pace after two furlongs will determine whether this becomes a tactical affair or genuine test

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace favours closers
scenarios.trigger: If Giorgio M and Harbour Vision maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The early leaders set up the race perfectly for the hold-up brigade. Farasi Lane, Cephalus and Chifa emerge from the pack with late runs to collar the pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front pair dominate proceedings
scenarios.trigger: If Giorgio M or Harbour Vision get loose on the lead with soft fractions

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent horses time it perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes messy with stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: He's A Gentleman and Highland Olly get the ideal trip tracking the leaders before striking. Their tactical position proves superior to both the pace-setters and hold-up horses who struggle to make ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield surge decides it
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses find themselves too far back when the race develops. Midnight's Dream and Habrdi, settling closer than usual, benefit from the moderate tempo to get first run on their rivals.

races.paceDynamic: With only one confirmed front runner in Bizou, this shapes as a moderate early gallop with Danehill Star, Phyllis Burton, The Pug and Man Is King likely to settle just behind in the second rank. The sustainable pace will suit the large contingent of hold-up horses including Marinakis, Wyvern and Abila, creating a scenario where stamina and finishing kick become decisive over the extended 9 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Bizou sets steady fractions and the prominent runners don't apply early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash late runs. Marinakis and Wyvern benefit most from their patient tactics paying off.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Danehill Star and Man Is King press forward early and sustain their effort
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to stretch the field but not collapse, favoring those with tactical speed. Danehill Star's excellent going record gives him the edge over fellow front-runner Man Is King.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains very sedate throughout and multiple horses arrive together
scenarios.body: A bunched field entering the straight creates a cavalry charge where the best turn of foot wins. Tiger Beetle and Abila have the class to excel in a rough finish despite limited recent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Bizou gets uncontested fractions and finds extra resolve in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The front runner builds an unassailable advantage while the pack behind gets in each other's way. Bizou's prominent style pays dividends if allowed easy time up front.

races.paceDynamic: Simplify will lead from the gates with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him, setting a manageable gallop over this sharp 5f course. Five prominent racers (Dark Angel Star, Kolkata Knight, The Lost Sock, Duskaura, Little Jaybee) will track closely behind the leader, creating a bunched field that could produce a cavalry charge finish. The sustainable early pace should favor horses with tactical speed, while hold-up horses Concert and Artista face the typical challenge of making up ground in a sprint.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Simplify Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Simplify gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage as the prominent runners fail to coordinate their challenge effectively. Simplify's recent winning form over 6f suggests the stamina to hold on, with The Lost Sock running into a place from his tracking position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Swarms Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners mount a coordinated challenge turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustained pace tells on Simplify as Kolkata Knight and Dark Angel Angel use their similar going records to maximum effect. Dark Angel Star's perfect 4/4 record on similar going gives him the edge in a tight finish with multiple prominent runners in contention.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes stronger than expected and the prominent pack goes too hard
scenarios.body: Concert and Artista benefit from the pace collapse, with Concert's versatility over different trips helping him pick up the pieces. The hold-up pair exploit tired legs ahead, though they need everything to fall perfectly over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favors Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Simplify goes too slow early and the field remains tightly bunched throughout
scenarios.body: Little Jaybee overcomes his finishing concerns by getting first run on a slowly-run race, while Duskaura's consistent 5f form helps him capitalize. The lack of early pace allows the entire field to remain competitive deep into the race.

scenarios.trigger: If Shipshape gets an easy lead and Tuba doesn't press early

scenarios.body: Tuba uses his prominent position to slip the field before the cavalry charge arrives from the back. The leaders fade but the hold-up horses react too late.

races.paceDynamic: Grand Echo will be the lone front runner, allowing him to dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure from pace rivals. With Jane Of The Jungle and Woody Y Fernandez settling just behind in prominent positions, the real tactical battle will unfold in the final 2f when 8 hold-up horses try to find racing room simultaneously behind what should be a solid but not overly strong early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Echo establishes a clear lead and the prominent horses don't apply enough pressure through the middle stages.
scenarios.body: Grand Echo maintains his advantage as the field bunches behind him, with the hold-up brigade struggling to make up the ground in time. The sustained gallop plays to his front-running style perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses all come with runs simultaneously in the final 2f creating interference.
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get hampered or forced to switch course, allowing the cleaner movers to capitalize. Those with early pace positioning avoid the worst of the scrimmaging.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the higher-rated hold-up horses gets a dream run through and times their challenge perfectly.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes solid enough to set up a closer but not so strong that Grand Echo can't be caught. A Lott Of Kane or Frankali gets the ideal split at the crucial moment.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Jane Of The Jungle and Woody Y Fernandez work together to put pressure on Grand Echo from halfway.
scenarios.body: The front runner cracks under the sustained pressure from the prominent pair who then have enough left to hold off the late closers. Racing luck favors the early positioned horses.

watchPoints.text: Grand Echo's early fractions will be crucial - if he goes too slow he's vulnerable, too fast and he'll stop.
Jane Of The Jungle and Woody Y Fernandez must not let Grand Echo get too far clear if they want to reel him in.
The draw and early positioning of A Lott Of Kane and Frankali as they need clean runs from their hold-up styles.
Telling Time's finishing kick pattern - whether he can finally sustain his effort to the line for once.
